items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: told his valet, name was Billy, give me some money

ctx.x: And so I had to pay for them. I think it was around about 1,600.00. Now, I'm making about $60.00 a week, and I got pretty burned up about that, plus Lunsford never bought any uniforms or paid for the uniforms that we wore in his band to make his band impressive.

So I just got filled up, and Bill Robinson in some theater, now -- I can't recall what theater we were in -- this man, after he heard me out there telling Lunsford off -- and I'm telling the God's truth -- he gave his -- told his valet, name was Billy, give me some money, give me some money. So he came out and told Lunsford, here -- wonder can I use this word I'm going to use.
Oh, you can use any word you want to. I hope they erase it
